segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The prophet Jeremiah spoke a hard word to a people who would not turn. The LORD said He would send searchers — and no hiding place would be far enough.

segments.speaker: god
segments.text: Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the LORD, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: It is a picture of judgment — the nets and the hunt find everyone.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: But hear the mercy underneath: the same God who sends the search is the one who wants them found, not lost. Judgment is the last call, not the first.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The point was never the catching — it was that a holy God would not let His people slip away unnamed. He seeks, even when seeking means discipline.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: For us the picture flips into hope: the Fisher of men searches still, not to condemn, but to bring home whoever will be found.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The hunt was a wake-up, not a goodbye. He's still searching for you — let yourself be found.
